title: World Bank support to reduce flooding in Saint Lucia
methodology: Publisher's flood-risk diagnosis and investment design.
limitations: Body publication date retained rather than URL date; proposed benefits are not realized outcomes.

title: Saint Lucia to strengthen resilience with World Bank support
limitations: Reported policies and intended financial readiness; no independent effectiveness evaluation.

title: Universal adaptive social protection
temporal_coverage: Programme and Saint Lucia vulnerability analysis using2016 household survey.
methodology: Programme description and substantive synopsis of gender-vulnerability analysis.
limitations: Historic survey and publication synopsis; no claim of current nationally representative vulnerability rates.

title: Climate Change Adaptation Planning for Castries, Saint Lucia
organization: World Bank; ICF GHK, King's College London and Grupo Laera
temporal_coverage: Castries hazard and adaptive-capacity assessment; many settlement and household indicators date from 2010-2012.
methodology: City-level flood/landslide hazard, social and institutional vulnerability assessment with an adaptation investment plan.
limitations: Baseline is primarily 2010-2012 and should not be treated as a current measurement of household conditions or institutional performance.

title: Saint Lucia: Flood Event of December 24-25, 2013 - Joint Rapid Damage and Needs Assessment
organization: Government of Saint Lucia and World Bank, with GFDRR and European Union support
temporal_coverage: Assessment of the 24-25 December 2013 flood; report issued March 2014.
methodology: Government-World Bank rapid damage and needs assessment spanning infrastructure, productive sectors, housing and social services.
limitations: Rapid post-event assessment; some losses and interior housing impacts were explicitly considered incomplete, and the findings are historical.

title: Disaster risk reduction in Saint Lucia: Situational analysis 2022
organization: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR)
methodology: UNDRR risk-profile synthesis of hazards, vulnerabilities, capacities and systemic risk-governance gaps.
limitations: Claims use the official report record's summary, not the linked 76-page report text; its findings are national rather than community-disaggregated.

title: UN and Eastern Caribbean Partners Convene to Strengthen Prevention of Youth Crime and Violence
organization: United Nations Barbados and Eastern Caribbean Multi-Country Office
temporal_coverage: Regional consultation on a proposed youth crime and violence programme, 1 May 2026.
methodology: Official UN report of a multi-country programme-design consultation and stakeholder remarks.
limitations: Regional framing and programme design, not a Saint Lucia-specific prevalence study or evaluation of implemented activities.
